access: World map SELECT -> Race Index -> International country groups. Also available in Race Editor. No fictional US campaign location assigned.
geometrySource: OpenStreetMap API bounded map snapshots, shared editor track importer; ODbL attribution retained on every race.
elevationSource: Mapzen/Tilezen Terrarium global terrain data, zoom 12; 64 road samples and a 5x5 surrounding terrain survey interpolated by the existing importer.
limitations: Not laser-scanned. DEM can include vegetation/buildings and does not measure track banking or bridge decks.
Unmapped widths use explicit 10 m / 12 m defaults.
Suzuka bridge clearance is an authored 6.5 m approximation over DEM heights; explicit network topology keeps both levels separate.
Circuit start lines are placed on suitable mapped straights by the existing line-placement audit, not surveyed official grid coordinates.
Tsukuba mapped lengths are approximately 2121 m / 943 m; geometry is not stretched to match published measurements.
Shared existing scenery and road textures are used; venue-specific grandstands and landmarks are not replicas.

This batch includes identifiable continuous mapped layouts, not every arbitrary connector combination, kart circuit, defunct oval or service road. Fuji Short labels describe mapped variants; they are not claimed official configuration codes.
